entry_points: launch_scientist_bfts.py __main__ (parses args, loads idea JSON, writes experiments/<date>_<name>_attempt_<id>/idea.md+idea.json, rewrites bfts_config.yaml via edit_bfts_config_file, calls perform_experiments_bfts, then aggregate_plots, gather_citations, perform_writeup/perform_icbinb_writeup, perform_review + perform_imgs_cap_ref_review, then kills child processes)
ai_scientist/perform_ideation_temp_free.py generate_temp_free_idea (LLM brainstorms/refines ideas from a topic .md with Semantic Scholar novelty tool; writes <topic>.json)

ai_scientist/treesearch/perform_experiments_bfts_with_agentmanager.py perform_experiments_bfts (loads cfg, preps workspace, builds AgentManager, runs it with exec/step callbacks and rich live tree display)

ai_scientist/treesearch/agent_manager.py AgentManager.run (experiment-manager: four hard-coded main stages 1 initial_implementation, 2 baseline_tuning, 3 creative_research, 4 ablation_studies, each with LLM-generated sub-stages; per sub-stage calls agent.step until _check_stage_completion / _check_substage_completion, then multi-seed eval + plot aggregation on best node)

ai_scientist/treesearch/parallel_agent.py ParallelAgent.step / _select_parallel_nodes (best-first tree search: picks num_workers nodes -- None=new draft while draft_nodes < num_drafts, buggy leaf to debug with prob debug_prob up to max_debug_depth, else journal.get_best_node to improve; stage 2/4 always expand best_stage1/best_stage3 node with LLM-generated hyperparam/ablation ideas; submits _process_node_wrapper to a process pool and appends result Nodes to the Journal)
ai_scientist/treesearch/parallel_agent.py MinimalAgent._draft/_debug/_improve (worker-side LLM prompts that produce plan+code; parse_exec_result and _analyze_plots_with_vlm judge the run)
ai_scientist/treesearch/interpreter.py Interpreter.run (executes LLM-written runfile.py in a child process with timeout, captures stdout/traceback)
ai_scientist/treesearch/journal.py Journal / Node (tree store; get_best_node asks an LLM to pick the best candidate unless use_val_metric_only)
example_input: A Markdown topic file with sections Title, Keywords, TL;DR, Abstract (example: ai_scientist/ideas/i_cant_believe_its_not_better.md), then the generated idea JSON (ai_scientist/ideas/i_cant_believe_its_not_better.json) plus optional seed code .py of the same stem for --load_code; tree-search settings in bfts_config.yaml

Main pipeline: experiments/<timestamp>_<ideaname>_attempt_<id>/ with logs/0-run/unified_tree_viz.html, experiment_results, idea.md/idea.json, token_tracker output, <timestamp_ideaname>.pdf paper, review_text.txt and review_img_cap_ref.json (from README and launch_scientist_bfts.py)

built_to: A generalized end-to-end agentic system that autonomously generates hypotheses, runs experiments, analyzes data and writes scientific manuscripts, and that 'has generated the first workshop paper written entirely by AI and accepted through peer review' (README).
pressure: The predecessor AI Scientist-v1 relied on human-authored templates; v2 'removes reliance on human-authored templates, generalizes across Machine Learning (ML) domains, and employs a progressive agentic tree search, guided by an experiment manager agent' (README), while noting v2 has lower success rates than v1 when a strong template exists.
success_means: Producing a completed paper PDF plus LLM/VLM review; README FAQ frames success as a per-run 'success rate' of completing experiments and generating a PDF, dependent on the foundation model and idea complexity, with a peer-review-accepted workshop paper as the headline result.
main_loop_one_sentence: AgentManager.run iterates four fixed main stages (initial_implementation -> baseline_tuning -> creative_research -> ablation_studies), and within each sub-stage repeatedly calls ParallelAgent.step, which selects num_workers tree nodes (new drafts until num_drafts roots exist, random buggy leaves to debug with probability debug_prob, otherwise the LLM-judged best good node to improve, or the fixed best stage-1/3 node for hyperparameter/ablation stages), has worker processes ask an LLM for plan+code, execute it via Interpreter with a timeout, parse metrics and VLM plot feedback into a Node, appends the Nodes to the stage Journal, and ends the stage when max_iterations is reached or an LLM judges the stage goals met, then runs multi-seed evaluation and plot aggregation on the best node before seeding the next stage with it.
behavioral_entry_point: ai_scientist/treesearch/parallel_agent.py:ParallelAgent._select_parallel_nodes (search policy) and ai_scientist/treesearch/agent_manager.py:AgentManager.__init__ main_stage_goals / _check_stage_completion (stage schedule and stopping); tunables in bfts_config.yaml agent.search (num_drafts, debug_prob, max_debug_depth) and agent.stages
